SELECT pl.purchase_number AS purchaseNumber, TO_CHAR(pl.purchase_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS purchaseDate, s.name AS supplierName, plg.code AS goodsCode, plg.name AS goodsName, plg.model AS goodsModel, gt.name AS typeName, plg.price AS goodsPrice, plg.num AS goodsNum, plg.unit AS unitName, plg.total AS totalPrice FROM t_purchase_list_goods plg LEFT JOIN t_purchase_list pl ON plg.purchase_list_id = pl.id LEFT JOIN t_supplier s ON pl.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN t_goods_type gt ON plg.type_id = gt.id WHERE 1=1
AND plg.name LIKE '%' || #{goodsName} || '%'
AND plg.type_id = #{typeId}
AND TRUNC(pl.purchase_date) >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TRUNC(pl.purchase_date) <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
ORDER BY pl.purchase_date DESC, plg.id DESC
